content.text: Every creator in a platform-restricted country eventually arrives at the same moment: the application rejected, the payout held, the account flagged for no stated reason. Stripe does not support your country. PayPal's compliance engine decided your location is high-risk. Gumroad cannot pay you because Stripe cannot move the money. These are not bugs. They are the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-explained-digital-creators-2|Selling Design]]-digital-art-without-paypal-2|architecture]] working exactly as designed — for a specific set of markets, and against yours. The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build infrastructure that does not depend on their permission to operate. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving 149 countries without access to its services. PayPal, while widely available, has country restrictions and account suspension risks, including holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle have country restrictions and limited functionality for creators in restricted areas. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to deploy their own digital storefronts, manage payments, and own their data, without relying on Stripe or other platforms. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that deploys in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and other platforms have country restrictions, which can leave creators without access to their services. PayPal's country restrictions are more complex, with some countries restricted entirely and others with limited functionality. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also have country restrictions, which can limit creators' abilities to sell digital products. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate in restricted countries, providing creators with a permanent solution that is not subject to country-specific restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and other platforms charge transaction fees, which can range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 10% or more, depending on the country and payment method. PayPal's fees are also complex, with a flat fee of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but with higher fees for some countries. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also charge transaction fees, which can range from 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction to 5% or more. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no country-specific restrictions or higher fees for certain payment methods.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround, but a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and other platforms require creators to rely on their infrastructure, which can limit ownership and control over digital products. PayPal's account suspension risks can also hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, leaving creators without access to their own money. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also have limitations on ownership and automation, which can make it difficult for creators to manage their digital products. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators with full ownership and control over their digital products, with automatic payment processing and file delivery through NOWPayments and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Creators who require a permanent solution that is not subject to country-specific restrictions should consider COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure. Those who need a pre-configured solution can opt for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). For creators who require a more complex infrastructure, COREMERCH offers a range of custom solutions, including the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which deploys in 48 hours with 3 products loaded and 30-day support. Ultimately, the choice of architecture depends on the creator's specific needs and requirements.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no country-specific restrictions or higher fees for certain payment methods.

You can also explore COREMERCH's other products and solutions on our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own digital storefront and manage payments without relying on Stripe or other platforms, follow these steps: Deploy your infrastructure using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, or Google Apps Script. Configure NOWPayments as your payment processor, which charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction. Set up automatic payment processing and file delivery using NOWPayments and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Deploy your digital products and configure your storefront to manage sales and customer data. Test your infrastructure to ensure smooth payment processing and delivery.
